task: VISION Ring three defect types; no verified normal labels; always REVIEW in deployment
scope: Additional experiments only. Existing models, metrics, web, Unity and presentations stay intact.

data.test_note: These 42 images were evaluated previously. This is a repeated historical benchmark, not a new unseen external test.
data.tiles_note: All five views of an image remain together in its original split. No annotation-derived crop or mask is used.

candidates.reason: Same-condition scratch-trained reference; preserves the original 256-pixel baseline separately.
Matches the existing lightweight MobileNet width; test its quality-cost tradeoff.
Check whether the existing width reduction sacrificed useful features.
Compare a larger residual-network feature extractor.

input.global_tiles: Whole image plus four fixed overlapping 65-percent corner crops, each resized to 160x160; concatenate whole feature, tile-feature mean and tile-feature max
input.ResNet50_preprocessing: Official preprocess_input, RGB to BGR and ImageNet channel centering
input.EfficientNetB0_preprocessing: Official ImageNet constructor including built-in normalization; input RGB float32 0..255; no external /255

architecture.transfer_backbone: Frozen ImageNet feature extractor; terminal global average pooling only in this study
architecture.scratch_backbone: Conv2D 32,64,128 with ReLU, MaxPool after first two convolutions, terminal global average pooling
architecture.important_difference: The previous 92.86-percent MobileNet model used multiscale intermediate features plus average/max pooling. It is a historical reference, not a controlled row in this new study.

training.cache: Frozen image features may be cached once; record feature-extraction time separately from head-training time. No test image is decoded before the selection lock.

selection.unit: Configuration (backbone,view), averaged over the three seeds
selection.main_backbone_comparison: Global-only rows, including the same-condition custom CNN
selection.export_note: Seed 42 is fixed in advance; never choose the run using test performance. No seed ensemble.
selection.lock: Write selection_lock.json and training artifact hashes before test decoding or scoring. Test results must not change the selected configuration.

measurement.variation: Mean and sample standard deviation over initializations on one fixed split; not cross-validation and not a confidence interval
measurement.latency: Same CPU/thread settings, batch=1, 5 warmups then 30 measurements; include resize/crops, official preprocessing, backbone and classifier; exclude disk decode/model load; report median and p95
measurement.timing_note: Latency is measured on the local machine, not a verified production cycle time.
